title: channels__ack — output
description: Output schema for the SOX channels__ack operation. Confirms the pending-state record has been updated. No channel message is created. Normative reference: spec/primitives/ack-nack.md.

message_id.description: The message_id that was acknowledged. Echoed from input.

status.description: The new pending-state status recorded by the server. Echoed from input.

acked_at.description: Unix epoch seconds (floating-point) at which the server recorded this status transition.
